book.name: Qayeeng yeip yaing
book.title: Kilisi talex qayeeng xupekeing yeip yaing wou Yoan

content: Qayeeng ne la wou kongrikesin wei toundei eivek Epeses o
Woyom tambiy tiyon neil no, “Wa byex qayeeng ne na wou angela wei kongrikesin wei toundei eivek Epeses o.
Inye qayeeng beimambei ne eno lam wou e wei mi zeim betum lim yuw eivek mema payeiv o me mi la senghoing eivek lam ghol vaxa lim yuw on.

A woulek kwa dalus wei wang on woy, me wa xe pok de kwa wei wang mi nale nikanzek eivek nimaying o. Me a xei bei wa laleim se vind xel moux wei nilul on, de wang axe xel wei neil embei xel sinale ekom ma mouyo, wang wei bei xel on tyonyeingana.
Wang mi nale nikanzek eivek nimaying me ghe qalei maying ngandoung on en a leing, de wa seng mi wo nimbayaing en pok ne.
Ekom a qayeeng ti wou wang. Wang saing wa xe kwa wei lalei vineing wei myaxeeng eno veil.

Inyei nambei wang tei gheyapu me ghe lam axone, wang bounaleim en kwa nimza wei wang mi wong myaxeeng o ekom ghe saing veil o! Wa pekwi xow me ghe bong xuk wei wang mi wong atax o. Wangwei wa se pekwi xow nei ond tyek a nak wou wang me na zeim wa nim lam vaxa veil e nimbeeng.
Ekom wa xe kwa nimza eno di yeip is wang. Wa laleim wo nol en xuk nilul wei Nikolasyeiw o, ay is ambei nyon a laleing se vind kwa wei xel on.

Woyom e ti nenyalis toundei lek e, yond e ngo embo nimza en vati wei Laweeng Vambuing di neil wou xel kongrikesin o. E ti bo vevek ghanaw nei on tyek a zewexe lek e bei ena gya xaxaneing wei mapieing o, wei toundei eivek beyeeng nimza wei Anutu yo.”
Qayeeng ne la wou kongrikesin wei toundei eivek Smena yo
Woyom tambiy tiyon neil no, “Wa byex qayeeng tine na wou angela wei kongrikesin wei toundei eivek Smena yo.
Inye qayeeng beimambei wei tambiy wei Myaxeeng me Yusayang o, wei mey de qandi lek mapieing no yo.

A xei wa xe myavanei wei wang qou yo me wa xe deing wei lulul ma veil wang o, ekom wang wo lulul ana! A xei xel wei mi lukyak me neil embei nyei xel Yudayeiw ekom xel on se Yuda qe xel on xomek qekueing ama wei Sandang o.

Wa seng gwaleeng en myavanei vati wei wa bim a qou yon. A neil wou wang bei, tambiy mapetok tyek na toung xam on valu eivek xeitueing bei daxe xam, me tyek xam qalei myavanei me nimaying teyei lek bouk xoumeeng. Ekom wa mi zeimaxoun wa xe wongeingis me ena tip lek ingwei wa mey yo, en tyek a bong qelumking wei mapieing nambei xouveing eno wou wang.

Woyom tambiy tiwei nenyalis toundei lek e yo, wong e ngo vati wei Laweeng Vambuing di neil wou xel kongrikesin o. Tambiy tiwei xoklek nimaying eno tyek meyeing nge wei yuw eno se semaleeng e, ma mouyo.”
Qayeeng ne la wou kongrikesin wei toundei eivek Pegamum o
Woyom tambiy tiyon neil no, “Wa byex qayeeng tine na wou angela wei kongrikesin wei toundei eivek beyeeng Pegamum o.
Inye qayeeng beimambei ne lam wou tambiy wei mi zeim ngeyeing vevek wei manewou yuw valuvalu xouing o.

A xei mang wou ingwei wang mindei, nanghei ingwei Sandang xe sia nei. Ekom neing bei wang ghei toundei me ghe di zeimaxoun a leing wo nikanzek. Wa seng saing wongeingis wei wang mi wongis ay yo veil me ela tip lek bouk wei Antipas o, inyei tambiy wei mi neil a xe qayeeng la teyei lek o, eno xel leis e mey eivek xam senghoing nanghei ingwei Sandang mindei nei.
Ekom a qayeeng valu wou wang, wa xe xomaxoneing valu nanghei di zeimaxoun qayeeng teyoxeing wei Balam
o, wei teyoxe wou Balak bei e zeim Israelyeiw laleind lek en xel bo sewokeing nangya ingwei xel ya yaeing wei xel wong ambei da wou anutu tyonyeing o, me ingwei xel la eivek kwa nilul wei kwapesiv o.
Woyom nambei inyon eno wa xe xel valu eno di zeimaxoun teyoxeing wei Nikolasyeiw o.
Nambei inyon xam pekwi xow! Enok, a nak daing wou xam me na bo vevek is xel angya ngeyeing vevek wei toundei eivek a myang o.

Woyom e tiwei nenyalis toundei lek e yo, wong e ngo vati wei Laweeng Vambuing di neil wou xel kongrikesin o. Tambiy tiwei xoklek nimaying o, tyek a bong mana valu wei mindei xupekeing eno wou e. Me tyek a bong qakous teleing ti is lei vako tiwei xel byex lek eno wou e, wei xelti se woulek inyon qe e wei qou yo venaxow.”
Qayeeng ne la wou kongrikesin wei toundei eivek Taiataira yo
Woyom tambiy tiyon neil no, “Wa byex qayeeng tine na wou angela wei kongrikesin wei toundei eivek Taiataira yo.
Inyei qayeeng beimambei wei Anutu Neu moux o, tambiy wei ma xok ambei nenyex tumeing magyand me tambiy wei vaxa xok ambei bras
wei xel lii e wo belin o.

A woulek wa xe xuk woy, me wa xe lalei vineing me wa xe wongeingis, me wa xe xuk vineing me ingwei wang mi nale nikanzek eivek nimaying o, me ingwei gweimbeeng ne wang di wong e ghanaw ingwei wang wong atax o.

Ekom a qayeeng valu wou wang. Wang mi lewexe lek vex tiwei Jesebel on, wei mi taxe xow bei e poropet vex ti. Me mi pakei a xe xukxeyeiw la eivek kwa nilul wei xel mi wong kwapesiv o nangya e xe teyoxeing, me ingwei xel mi ya yaeing wei xel wong ambei da wou tenu bandaing eno nangya e xe teyoxeing.
A wong bouk wou e bei e pekwi xow, ekom embei se pekwi xow me na toung demi wou e xe kwapesiv on.

Om tyek a bo vanei ngandoung wou vex on me na ni e lek zek wei myavanei yo, me xel wei mi wo kwapesiv is vex on, ek wangwei xel se pekwi xow veil e xe sakwaing nilul nei yon tyek a bong xel a qou myavanei ngandoung is ambei nyon.

Tyek a nyeis vex on neuyeiw na mey. Woyom kongrikesin dalus tyek boulek bei a ne moux wei a mi xeila xel laleind me xel lundpeyei, me tyek am bo xouveing wou xam titi teyei lek xam xe kwa wei xam ghe mi wong on.

Ekom gweimbeeng a neil wou xam valu wei nanghei toundei eivek Taiataira yon, me ena wou xam wei seng mi zeimaxoun vex on xe teyoxeing me xam seng qou lupeyei wou kwa wei xel taxe bei lul xupekeing wei manghembi wei Sandang o. (Me tyek a se toung nimaying nge nak lek xam).
Qe xam mendi zeimaxoun kwa nimza vati wei xam xe yon bo nikanzek deka a nak le.
Eti yeiw wei mi xoklek nimaying o me betiwou a laleing me e na tyip wou bouk wei lulul la tip lek o, tyek a bong nikanzek wei lei ngandoung wei e bo lukanzek en xomaxoneing tembuing tambak eno wou e.
‘Moxo tyek gyei xel teyei is patongeeng wei aen o, de tyek dembu xel na bo myapapu nambei dengmuing.’
Nambei kawei a qou nikanzek wei lei ngandoung wou mang o.
Me tyek am bong betum wei satiboukeing eno wou e is ambei inyon.
Om tambiy wei nenyalis toundei lek e yo, wong e ngo ewo nimza en vati wei Laweeng Vambuing di neil wou xel kongrikesin o.”

footnotes.text: Balam on inyei poropet ti. De Balak on inye king.
